[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/e1c5a7ac1f817694348384e02490416723e6ee46.png[/img]
[b]「 LSP Banned? Is This Game Serious or Not 」[/b]
LoveStoryProject ◆Serious Games Festival 2024 is heating up this summer, from August 8th to 19th, with lots of surprises and benefits waiting for you. Come and check it out!

[h1]New Releases[/h1]

[h3]◆ New Releases[/h3]
Serious new games are fun and affordable, launching consecutively in early August—
Several LSP new titles recommended by the customer service girl have been officially released or have new versions. Don't miss the launch discounts~

August 6-7: Releases of "Flower Romance Moon", "Heart's Distance"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956280
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797180

August 7: "Photo Idol" V1.5 update

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696120

August 9: New Demo release of "Weaver's Song"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2223420

[h3]◆ LSP Project New Titles Announced[/h3]
New LSP titles to be released after Q3 2024 will be revealed daily from August 12—
On August 15, you can also participate in the #LSP Lottery# to win [custom activation codes] for all new titles and lock in your spot early!

Reveal page: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/]https://www.lspsp.me/[/url]

[h1]Discounts and Bundles[/h1]

[h3]◆ LSP Romance Game Sale[/h3]
Missed the summer sale? No worries, crazy "historical lows" continue——
From August 8 to August 19, enjoy historical low prices on the LSP romance game series!

Sale venue: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/LSPGAL/list/129593]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/LSPGAL/list/129593[/url]

[h3]◆ Limited Time Theme Bundles[/h3]
Customer service girl loves bundles, collect a set for a surprise——
We created three themed limited-time event bundles: [Pure Love], [Gameplay], and [Yuri], available until August 19. Collect a set to not only enjoy additional discounts but also receive event-exclusive physical merchandise sets.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43875
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43876
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43877

[h3]◆ Permanent Brand Bundles[/h3]
Bundle up the producer! Permanent brand bundles are now available——
Taking advantage of the event, we also collaborated with Hollowings, G-MODE, and Zhi Yu Studio to launch bundles of works with similar themes from the same production team, allowing you to always get new or old works from the same producer at a discounted price.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43036
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43874
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43508

[h1]Freebies[/h1]

[h3]◆ Limited Edition Merchandise Giveaway[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/59dc95a33b6833b71cd7e4d790d0e6324488333d.png[/img]
We have created fun visual merchandise with the main visual: "LSP Banned Desk Flip" transparent file folder and "Serious or Not?" lenticular card. Participate in the event to receive them for free——

How to get it:

Participate in the LSP Lottery
Just have all the games in any one of the limited-time themed bundles in your Steam library to receive guaranteed merchandise through the LSP Lottery.
[list]
[*]Participation link: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery]https://www.lspsp.me/lottery[/url]
[*]Event period: August 8 - August 19 (limited to the first 100 people, while supplies last)[/list]
Repost on Weibo
Repost the event Weibo to participate in the repost lottery, and 10 lucky fans will receive event-exclusive merchandise sets. Details below.
[h3]◆ LSP+1 Daily Stock Replenishment[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/a1dca6f07d24fbfdf3b21d594b8928f578d15a81.jpg[/img]
From August 8 to August 14, LSP+1 stock will be refreshed every working day. Including new titles such as "Succuboss: My Boss is a Succubus" and restocking of old titles, a total of 1000 activation codes will be given away.

Claim benefits: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/bonus]https://www.lspsp.me/bonus[/url]

[h3]◆ Exclusive Gift Pack Lottery[/h3]
LSP website V3 or higher level users can also participate in an exclusive lottery to win a gift pack, taking home the Steam activation codes for 8 titles on discount in this event. A total of 5 sets, good luck!
[list]
[*]Participation link: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery]https://www.lspsp.me/lottery[/url]
[*]Event period: August 8 - August 19 (limited to the first 100 people, while supplies last)[/list]
*Gift pack contents: Steam activation codes for "Succuboss: My Boss is a Succubus", "Wandering Street", "Mirror Flower Candy Love", "Pure Love Monologue: Little", "Fantasy Cao Cao 2", "Mage of the Kingdom of Gods", "Vacuum Valkyrie", "Day and Night"

[h3]◆ Weibo Lottery[/h3]
Repost the event Weibo for a chance to win the following prizes——
[list]
[*] First Prize: ￥888 cash red envelope × 1
[*] Second Prize: ￥50 Steam recharge card × 3
[*] Third Prize: Event-exclusive merchandise set × 10
[/list]
Event Weibo: [url=https://weibo.com/u/5877446372]https://weibo.com/u/5877446372[/url]

That's all the information for this event. Enjoy your games!

notes.title: Collaboration Skin Available
notes.content:
Hi, everyone—

We recently updated the game to bring you some exciting collaboration benefits that went live today, as well as a bundle offer you might be interested in.

[h3]◆ New Collaboration Skins[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/d11a7ca18bfff569cb4c14f935859adc0520cc42.jpg[/img]
The "SuccuBoss x Fantasy of Caocao 2" collaboration skin [b]<Hattori Hanzo Rhythmic Gymnastics Ver.>[/b] is now available for redemption and exchange. Players who own this game can claim a redemption code for the skin from the link below. The redemption code can be used in "Fantasy of Caocao 2" on the "Collection - Partner" page for the corresponding partner card to receive the collaboration skin.

Redemption page: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/gift/foc]https://www.lspsp.me/gift/foc[/url]

Additionally, the redemption pages for the "Xiao Qiao" and "Cai Wenji" Tricolour Lovestory collaboration skins have been moved here. Both events are permanent, so you can redeem the skin codes anytime here~

[h3]◆ Bundle Available[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/7abe01572d73f2b46b2346d3e9b35c603691894a.jpg[/img]

We have launched a limited-time discount bundle "LSP Hentai Bundle 'Pinkish'," which includes "Fantasy Cao Cao 2" and "SuccuBoss💋." We hope this brings some savings to fans of spicy games ♥

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42102/

Thank you for your continued support of "FOC2", and we wish you an enjoyable gaming experience!

notes.title: Skin Updates & Chinese New Year Sale
notes.content:
Dear Caocao:

[b]Happy Chinese New Year![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/f1eb8cb828b631503aeaa6a61f218fc66cfcdc33.jpg[/img]

I am pleased to report to you—
Our DLC - Skin Pack has received a free update today, featuring new skins for companions in the "T.K. Punk" series. Users who have purchased the skins can obtain brand-new skins for four companions, including "Zuo Ci," "Zhang Xingcai," "Guan Yinping," and "Lv Lingqi," for free through the [Update⬇] button in the library. Open the game and take a look!

The new game by Sunny Game has now opened its store page. Welcome to add it to your wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505590

In addition, "Fantasy Cao Cao Biography 2" is participating in the 2024 "Chinese New Year Sale"—
During the Spring Festival from February 7th to 16th, enjoy a historic low discount of -30% on the game itself, and the "DLC - Skin Gift Pack" is offering an unprecedented 25% new low discount. Collect the full set with the base game for just +8.1 yuan.

[h2]◆ Discount Details ◆[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36190/2/

notes.title: Thank you for 10,000 downloads! (｡>∀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/394becf575beb51592ff43ac956d7deb29f888ad.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to inform everyone that the number of players of "Fantasy of Caocao  2" has exceeded 10,000 in less than 2 months since its release~!
To commemorate this milestone moment, we have prepared interesting updates and abundant benefits. Let's take a look together——

[h3]◆ Community Items On Sale[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/8ec52b18fe0df0d525212e2b28dbbaf1ac132c89.jpg[/img]
① The collectible card series is launched. Let's manage finances together!
The content includes a set of badges, 15 cards, 8 personal profile page backgrounds, and 5 small expressions. Once approved, card drops will begin. In the slow winter days, why not play some endless mode and collect cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/fb506474a4285adeddafb931e84bc31c7c991611.gif[/img]
② Follow-up to the points store series, Nine-Tailed Fox decorates your profile page
We have created attractive animated avatars and backgrounds that you can spend points on in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop][b]Points Store[/b][/url].

[h3]◆ DLC New Skin Updates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/9e9e284bcb4af695d201ff37e7a5eacf14cc2f64.jpg[/img]
The modest and tempting nun and the dancer with both passion and coolness!
The game's DLC skin package has free updates for 2 skins in total, featuring the popular companions "Zuo Ci" in a nun outfit and "Valkyrie" in a drummer major outfit. If you like them, buy them!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2426760/2/

[h3]◆ Workshop Opened[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/15fd129d9032ae30ad17eb9620ffe8426c5e7957.jpg[/img]
Is this... the mechanism of Huang Yueying!?
The game's workshop has quietly opened. You can customize and submit your own mods through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1913420/workshop/][b]Workshop page[/b][/url] of Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2, currently supporting customization of title pages and companion skins.

[h3]◆ Welfare Feedback[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/b5122c5dc66c97ef84fb36d81556739c7ea98ab4.png[/img]
① 100 free DLCs, come and get them for free
Giveaway of 100 skin packages with activation codes, users who already have the base game can participate in the draw.

Event link: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery#lottery-98]https://www.lspsp.me/lottery#lottery-98[/url]
Deadline: January 4, 2024
（For players in mainland China only）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/6b043085814e7d2d2f0854413fff07019ac7ba79.jpg[/img]
② Peripheral welfare feedback, free shipping in mainland China
・Specially designed "Changing Clothes, No Peeking" character handkerchief. The picture shows Cai Wenji and Xiao Qiao changing linked makeup, suitable for wrapping small items and wiping glasses.
・The well-received limited edition "Zuo Ci 3D Stereoscopic Silicone Mouse Pad" is added in quantity, and 50 lucky players will be selected to receive it.

Event link: [url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery#lottery-97]https://www.lspsp.me/lottery#lottery-97[/url]
Deadline: January 4, 2024
（For players in mainland China only）

[h3]◆ Of course, there are also discounts![/h3]
From December 21 to January 4, during the Steam Winter Sale, purchasing "Fantasy of Caocao  2" and "DLC - Skin Package" will enjoy a record low discount of 25% and 20% respectively~! Purchasing the bundle will get you an additional discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36190/2/

Above is all the content of the event. Thank you for your support of "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2," and welcome to participate!
